content.text:
Tavily has four paid monthly plans, according to its docs and help center:

| Plan | Price/month | Credits/month |
|---|---|---|
| Project | $30 | 4,000 |
| Bootstrap | $100 | 15,000 |
| Startup | $220 | 38,000 |
| Growth | $500 | 100,000 |

Tavily also offers these non-subscription options:
- **Researcher (free):** 1,000 credits per month.
- **Pay As You Go:** $0.008 per credit, with no commitment.
- **Enterprise:** custom pricing and limits.

My two sources disagreed. The pricing page I fetched showed only the Project plan, probably because the other tiers sit behind its plan slider. The docs and the help center list all four plans, and the help center's figures match for Project and Bootstrap. The Startup and Growth numbers come from the docs-based search summary, so check the live pricing page before you buy. CostBench and similar third-party sites show different names and prices, and I didn't use them.

Sources:
- [Tavily API credits docs](https://docs.tavily.com/guides/api-credits)
- [Tavily help center: pricing](https://help.tavily.com/articles/8816424538-pricing)
- [Tavily pricing page](https://www.tavily.com/pricing)
- [Firecrawl: Tavily pricing breakdown](https://www.firecrawl.dev/blog/tavily-pricing)
